message.content:
Yes! In Atlanta, you can file a noise complaint through the City’s official channels. Here’s how:

| Step | Action | Contact |
|------|--------|---------|
| **1** | **Online Filing** | Visit the City of Atlanta’s “Noise Complaint” portal at [noisecomplaint.atlantaga.gov](https://noisecomplaint.atlantaga.gov/). You’ll need to create an account or log in if you already have one. |
| **2** | **Phone Call** | Call the City of Atlanta Police Department’s non-emergency line at **(404) 656‑2000**. They will direct you to the appropriate unit handling noise violations. |
| **3** | **In-Person** | If you prefer face-to-face assistance, you can visit the nearest police precinct or the City Hall’s public safety office. |

### Tips for Filing a Noise Complaint

- **Provide Details:** Include the location, time, duration, and nature of the noise. If possible, attach audio recordings or photos as evidence.
- **Be Specific:** Mention whether it’s a residential or commercial area, and note any relevant zoning or building codes that might apply.
- **Follow Up:** After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy for any follow-up inquiries.

If you’re unsure which precinct covers your neighborhood, you can find a precinct map on the City of Atlanta Police Department’s website or call the main line for guidance.

Feel free to let me know if you need help navigating the online portal or preparing your complaint details!
